# pocketpull

> Run-once Go CLI that copies every Pocket recording's transcript, metadata and summaries into a local raw folder, for cron-driven archiving that feeds a downstream wiki agent.

CGO-free static Linux amd64/arm64 binary; no runtime needed on the collection host. One-way archive: it never edits Pocket and never prunes local snapshots.

## Docs
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): build from source, install a release, versions
- [Usage](docs/usage/): configuration and credentials, collection behaviour (refresh, state, raw artifacts, retries)
- [Operations](docs/operations/): cron scheduling, logs and exit status
